meta.title: Kolkata Pujo Guide – Durga Puja pandal hopping map
meta.description: Mobile-friendly map of Kolkata's Durga Puja pandals with crowd levels, restrooms, parking, eateries and special events. Works on weak networks.
meta.pandalsDescription: Search Kolkata's Durga Puja pandals by name, area, zone, theme or crowd level, and see the least crowded ones right now.
meta.eateriesTitle: Puja food – eateries near the pandals
meta.eateriesDescription: Street food, Bengali thali, sweets, biryani and cafés across Kolkata, with famous Puja-time favourites highlighted.
meta.eventsTitle: Durga Puja events – Shashthi to Bhasan
meta.eventsDescription: Day-by-day Puja events in Kolkata: rituals, cultural evenings, dhunuchi naach, sindur khela and Bhasan (immersion).
meta.moreDescription: Parking, restrooms, language, dark mode and information about this guide.
meta.parkingDescription: Parking areas across Kolkata with fees, capacity and the pandals nearby.
meta.restroomsDescription: Public, paid and venue restrooms across Kolkata with accessibility and distance.
meta.nearMeDescription: Use your location to find the closest pandals, restrooms, parking and eateries.

more.title: Menu
more.aboutText: An unofficial guide for visitors pandal hopping across Kolkata during Durga Puja. It uses open data and visitor input, and is not affiliated with any puja committee or authority.
more.dataText: Pandal list and zones are compiled from public listings. Restroom, parking and eatery points come from OpenStreetMap. Crowd levels are estimates plus visitor reports. Nothing here is verified yet.
more.translationNote: The Bengali translation is a machine-drafted first version and is awaiting review.

location.promptTitle: Allow location to see pandals, restrooms, parking and food near you.
location.promptWaiting: Your browser is asking for permission. Tap Allow.
location.privacy: Your location stays on your device and is never stored.
location.pickOnMap: Pick a point on the map
location.dismissedBody: No problem. Tap the button whenever you're ready, or pick your area instead.
location.blockedTitle: Location is turned off for this site.
location.blockedBody: Turn it back on to see what's near you, or pick your area instead.
location.stepsHeading: How to turn it back on
location.stepsAndroid1: Tap the lock or settings icon left of the address.
location.stepsAndroid2: Tap Permissions, then Location, then Allow.
location.stepsAndroid3: Come back here. We'll notice, or tap Try again.
location.stepsIos1: Tap the aA icon in the address bar, then Website Settings.
location.stepsIos3: Still stuck? Open Settings, then Privacy & Security, then Location Services. Make sure it is on and set Safari Websites to While Using the App.
location.stepsDesktopTitle: Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a computer
location.stepsDesktop1: Click the lock or settings icon left of the address bar.
location.stepsDesktop2: Set Location to Allow. In Safari, use the Safari menu, then Settings for This Website.
location.stepsDesktop3: We'll notice the change. If nothing happens, reload the page.
